# Toggle Button

Keep one action pressed until the same action is invoked again.

## Examples

### Formatting

Keep a formatting action pressed until the same action is invoked again.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the current value. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move through the normal document focus order. |

## Accessibility

The button exposes pressed state and keeps disabled and readonly behavior distinct.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) for the host accessibility contract.
